reachDefinition.indexable: the page's tier holds a derived threshold in thresholds.json and the page meets it
reachDefinition.band: the page's tier holds no derived threshold and the page is at or above that tier's ruleAnswerAfterStubFloor

issues: 8 second-opinion merge rows rest on a sentence the corpus record does not bear out (spine-attached.parquet); each is held, and the rows are listed in data/revamp/identity-review.md under "Where the second opinion and the corpus record disagree"
36 of the 680 rows repeat a pair already present under a different origin; the apply and hold lists carry one row per pair and name the repeats

all 150 already-merged rows confirmed against presence-applicable.ndjson: the named source key is absent from the live corpus and the survivor is present, so the merge is in force and the row carries no decision

none of the 150 already-merged source keys appears in identity/merge-map.json, which holds 61 entries and records this run's pass-4 merges only; the pass 2/3 merges are evidenced by the source key's absence from the live corpus instead

2 page(s) appear on both the apply list and the hold list (HOLD:existing:anhydrous-citric-acid, HOLD:existing:potassium-citrate); apply the licensed row before the held pair is reopened so the held pair is decided against the surviving page

8 apply-list rows come from the pairs the first pass held as a whole chain because an exception class separates another link of that chain; applying them needs the transitive closure checked so no exception-separated pages are joined

the residual band has no recorded definition in data/revamp, so this script defines it from thresholds.json: a tier with no derived threshold contributes its own ruleAnswerAfterStubFloor set (tier 2 at 8 present fields), which is the set thresholds.json measures as clearing the positional line and missing the lexical line; tier 1 holds a threshold so its rule-answer set is the indexable set, and tier 3 has no rule answer
